                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Rejection" name="Rejection"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Bring in defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_CRS" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Acceptance" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Rejection" name="Rejection" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Bring in defective computer">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Start_Bring</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Start_Bring</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Bring_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Bring_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Customer_Decision" name="Are the costs acceptable?" default="Flow_Customer_Reject">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Accept_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer_Accept" name="Accept repair costs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Accept_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Reject_Home</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Home_End</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Start_Bring" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[acceptable]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_Customer_Decision" targetRef="Task_SendRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept_End" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_Customer_Accept"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject_Home" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Home_End" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_Customer_Home"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS repair process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CRS" name="Receive defective computer">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Start_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Computer" messageRef="Message_Computer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Start_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Check_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCalculation" name="Prepare repair cost calculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Check_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Calculate_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Calculate_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Send_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" name="Wait for customer decision">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Send_Decision</bpmn:incoming>

    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_Rejected" name="Repair declined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Reject_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectRepair" name="Select repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Accept_Repair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Error_Retry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Select_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Select_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeTests" name="Continue from functionality test">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Tests_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Was an error detected?" default="Flow_NoError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Tests_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Error_Retry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Check_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_PrepareCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Calculate_Send" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCalculation" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Send_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Acceptance" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_SelectRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_CRS_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Hardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRepair" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_MergeTests"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Software" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRepair" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_MergeTests"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tests_Decide" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeTests" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Error_Retry" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_SelectRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="End_CRS_RepairFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetrySoftware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestRetrySoftware" targetRef="Gateway_MergeRetries"/>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Computer" name="Defective computer"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Customer_Start_Bring</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Bring_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_CostCalculation">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Initial_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Error_RetrySelect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoError</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair" name="Select another repair activity">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Software</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryHardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryHardware_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetrySoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetrySoftware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestRetrySoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetrySoftware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetrySoftware_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetryMerge" name="Continue from retry test">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetryHardware_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RetrySoftware_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RetryMerge_ErrorDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Check_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_PrepareCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Calculate_Send" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCalculation" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Send_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Acceptance" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept_InitialSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_InitialRepairSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_CRS_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Initial_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialRepairSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_InitialRepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Initial_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialRepairSplit" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_InitialRepairJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialJoin_ErrorDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_InitialRepairJoin" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Error_RetrySelect" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="End_CRS_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Hardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair" targetRef="Task_RetryHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetryHardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RetryHardware" targetRef="Task_TestRetryHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetryHardware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestRetryHardware" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Software" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair" targetRef="Task_RetrySoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetrySoftware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RetrySoftware" targetRef="Task_TestRetrySoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetrySoftware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_TestRetrySoftware" targetRef="Gateway_RetryMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RetryMerge_ErrorDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_RetryMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Wait_Acceptance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Accept_Repair</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive rejection" messageRef="Message_Rejection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Wait_Rejection</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CRS_Reject_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_Rejected" name="Repair declined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Reject_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Split" name="Perform both repair activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CRS_Accept_Repair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfigureSoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Join" name="Both activities and tests complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Hardware_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Software_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_ErrorDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorDetected" name="Was an error detected?" default="Flow_NoError">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_ErrorDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_Merge_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Error_Retry</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoError</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CRS_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoError</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair" name="Select another arbitrary repair activity">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Error_Retry</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Hardware</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Software</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetryHardware" name="Check and repair hardware">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_Hardware</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Hardware_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetestHardware" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_Hardware_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retest_Hardware_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetrySoftware" name="Check and configure software">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_Software</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Software_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetestSoftware" name="Test system functionality after software configuration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_Software_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retest_Software_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Retry_Merge" name="Continue from retry test">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retest_Hardware_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retest_Software_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Retry_Merge_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Start_Check" sourceRef="Start_CRS" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Check_Send" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_SendCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Send_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SendCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Acceptance" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Wait_Rejection" sourceRef="Gateway_CRS_WaitDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept_Repair" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject_End" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_CRS_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Split" targetRef="Task_RepairHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RepairHardware" targetRef="Task_TestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Hardware_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Software" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Split" targetRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_ConfigureSoftware" targetRef="Task_TestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Software_Join" sourceRef="Task_TestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ErrorDecision" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Join" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Error_Retry" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[errorDetected]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoError" name="No error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected" targetRef="End_CRS_RepairFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Hardware" name="Hardware" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair" targetRef="Task_RetryHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Hardware_Test" sourceRef="Task_RetryHardware" targetRef="Task_RetestHardware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retest_Hardware_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RetestHardware" targetRef="Gateway_Retry_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Software" name="Software" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectRetryRepair" targetRef="Task_RetrySoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Software_Test" sourceRef="Task_RetrySoftware" targetRef="Task_RetestSoftware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retest_Software_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RetestSoftware" targetRef="Gateway_Retry_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Retry_Merge_Decision" sourceRef="Gateway_Retry_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorDetected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description makes continuation depend on a decision and states distinct outcomes, including one that ends the process and one that continues: Model a separate outgoing sequence flow for each stated outcome, connecting each to its described termination or continuation.
rules.situation: the description makes continuation depend on a decision and states distinct outcomes, including one that ends the process and one that continues

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes an event or activity by its action, actor, object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier: Label each BPMN element so that it preserves those stated details without substituting a broader or different meaning.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity includes multiple actions

rules.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules.situation: the description requires every one of several distinct activities to be completed but does not prescribe their order

rules.instruction: When the description identifies an activity by its action and object, or distinguishes it from neighboring activities: Label the BPMN activity with the action and object supported by the description; do not substitute an inferred action or fold a neighboring activity into its label.
rules.situation: the description identifies an activity by its action and object, or distinguishes it from neighboring activities

rules.instruction: When the description requires multiple activities to be completed but permits them in any order, and describes a check after each activity that determines whether further work or completion follows: Model routing that allows every required activity to occur in a permitted order, include the described check after each activity, and route its outcomes to either further work or completion.
rules.situation: the description requires multiple activities to be completed but permits them in any order, and describes a check after each activity that determines whether further work or completion follows
